title: [Bug] macOS keyboard shortcuts for thinking toggle not working (Option+T, Tab)

top_comments.body: If you're on iTerm, go to the iTerm preferences -> Profiles -> Keys -> set the Left/Right Option key to Esc+.

top_comments.body: i can confirm just using esc+t is now a workaround to toggle on mac
